ops.title: codex CLI hangs indefinitely on this machine (auth/network) — route review lanes to opus/fable subagents instead
ops.body:
As of 2026-07-03, every `codex` CLI invocation on this machine hangs forever with zero CPU
and no session log — including `codex login status` and trivial `codex exec` smoke tests,
across sandbox flags. 17+ stale hung `codex login status` processes had accumulated from
prior sessions. It is an environment-wide auth/network hang, not a prompt or flags issue.

**Why:** the yclaw CLAUDE.md Models table routes diff review, refuter passes, and
security-sensitive verification to gpt-5.5 via the codex skill; every such dispatch
wastes a full agent turn discovering the hang.

**How to apply:** until codex works again (verify with a quick `codex login status` under
`timeout 15`), run those lanes as direct opus-xhigh finder/refuter subagents with fable
synthesis. Kill stale `codex` processes when found. Related: [[security-hardening-2026-06]].
